sharedPost.text:
Du bist auf der Suche nach einer Gesangslehrerin, 
die Professionalität und internationale Erfahrung mitbringt und Dir mit viel Enthusiasmus, Motivation , Energie und Freude das Singen und alles, was dazu gehört, beibringt ?
Dann bist Du hier, bei mir, genau richtig!

Ich freue mich auf genau Dich!

Ihre/ Eure
Annette Kuhn
www.annette-kuhn.de
Mail: annettekuhngreiner@gmail.com

items.text:
🎄 CHRISTMAS ELF CASTING – 2026 GROTTO CONTRACT 🎄
We're casting for our magical Christmas Grottos across the UK – and we’re on the lookout for charismatic, professional Christmas Elves to join the team!

📆 Contract: November – December 2026
💸 Rate: Varies per venue, TBC via email 

📍 Locations: 
* Harlestone Heath - Northampton
* Newbridge – Horsham

✨ Requirements:
• Entry-level acting skills
• Basic script work and immersive performance ability
• Confident group singing of children’s Christmas songs

🧝‍♀️ We’re looking for:
• Confident, energetic performers with great improvisation skills
• Friendly, reliable team players
• Previous experience working with children or in character-based roles is a plus

📌 Important Info:
• Costume and full training provided
• Paid rehearsals and site visits will be scheduled in early November – exact dates TBC
• Below is the confirmed list of working dates and shift times:
( Please note these are the most shifts available at one venue, shifts WILL vary per different venue) 

✅ Shift Dates & Times

- Saturday 21st Nov 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Sunday 22nd Nov 9:00AM to 4:45PM
- Saturday 28th Nov 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Sunday 29th Nov 9:00AM to 4:45PM
- Friday 4th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Saturday 5th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Sunday 6th Dec 9:00AM to 4:45PM
- Thursday 10th Dec 10:30AM to 6:00PM
- Friday 11th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Saturday 12th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM 
- Sunday 13th Dec 9:00AM to 5:00PM
- Thursday 17th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Friday 18th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Saturday 19th Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Sunday 20th Dec 9:00AM to 5:00PM
- Monday 21st Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Tuesday 22nd Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Wednesday 23rd Dec 8:30AM to 6:00PM
- Thursday 24th Dec 8:15AM to 4:15PM

📩 To apply:
Send your CV, headshot, and any relevant performance footage to: castings@evokeents.com

Subject line: CHRISTMAS ELF CASTING along with your desired venue

Tell us a little about why you’d be a great fit & the dates you're interested in working — we’d love to hear from you!

Talent przyciąga uwagę. A co sprawia, że publiczność zapamiętuje występ? Emocje, osobowość sceniczna i kontakt z widzami. 🎭

Nazywam się Katarzyna Maria Zawadzka. Jestem aktorką, trenerką aktorstwa i pedagogiem. Wspieram dzieci i młodzież występujące w tańcu, śpiewie, akrobatyce, aktorstwie, recytacji i innych dziedzinach artystycznych.

Pomagam młodym artystom wzmacniać pewność siebie na scenie, rozwijać ekspresję emocjonalną i przyciągać uwagę publiczności oraz jury. Pracujemy nad tym, by mogli pokazać nie tylko swoje umiejętności, ale też własną osobowość.

Jeśli Twoje dziecko przygotowuje się do występu lub konkursu, napisz do mnie: kmzawadzkatrener@gmail.com. Chętnie porozmawiam o tym, jak mogę je wesprzeć.

#MłodziArtyści #PewnośćSiebieNaScenie #WystępySceniczne #TaniecŚpiew #Akrobatyka

**WARSZAWA**

**3 / 5 października**

**Serial fabularny KB**

** **

Na plan serialu fabularnego KB szukam statystów na kolejne 2 dni:

** **

**3 PAŹDZIERNIKA (sobota):**

Gramy przed szpitalem i na sali operacyjnej

**- PERSONEL MEDYCZNY / PACJENCI i PRZECHODNIE** – wiek i płeć zróżnicowana. Stawka 120 zł gotówką po planie

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **statyści z autami. Auta na parkingu przed szpitalem. Z wyłączeniem białych aut.. Stawka **170 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

 

**5 PAŹDZIERNIKA (poniedziałek):**

Gramy zajazd niedaleko granicy.

**- KLIENCI ZAJAZDU - **wiek i płeć zróżnicowana. Stawka 120 zł gotówką po planie

**- STATYŚCI Z AUTAMI -  **statyści z autami. Auta na parkingu przed zajazdem. Z wyłączeniem białych aut.. Stawka **170 zł gotówką**. Zdjęcie auta poproszę w zgłoszeniu.

** **

 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **KB 3 lub KB 5**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i sylwetki**

 

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

items.text:
Casting Call (Short Film Paid)
Title: ELEKTRIK KATZENJAMMER

Genre: Psychological Thriller

Logline: The humdrum life of a corporate lackey is transformed when he discovers a mysterious cassette tape that brings him uncanny good fortune. However, in following the cryptic instructions the tape delivers, he finds that his newfound lucky breaks have made him the target of something far more sinister… 

Roles:

THE BOSS (Lead) Male, 40-50s, any race

Description: Years of self-preservation in a soulless capitalist bureaucracy have rendered The Boss greedy, insensate, and casually chauvinistic. However, beneath his vulgarity is a keen intellect that is always scanning for leverage and assessing the quickest route to an advantage. He is not outright evil, but his morality is flexible, especially when there is something to be gained, and he has climbed the corporate ladder through a combination of predatory instincts, oily charm, and an uncanny ability to recognize which way the wind is blowing.

LINDA (Supporting) Female, 40s, any race

Description: An ornery corporate matron. Her years of service have made her so indispensable to the company that firing her would constitute an act of administrative suicide. She has no particular ambitions to climb the corporate ladder, as she has already fashioned her little corner of the bureaucracy into a personal fiefdom. She is always prepared to die on the hill of whatever task is in front of her. Blunt, snippy, and occasionally inappropriate, she is in many ways a kindred spirit to the Boss, albeit one with less interest in upward mobility and more interest in making sure everyone else does their damn job.

LUCAS (Supporting) Male, 20s, any race

The yuppie naïf is the only one around the office who has not yet had his spirit crushed by the unending corporate drudgery. Painfully earnest and open-hearted, Lucas believes that enthusiasm is contagious, people mean well, and things always work out eventually. Although his eagerness is frequently mistaken for self-absorption, the truth is that Lucas simply has a lot to say, and he desperately wants someone to be interested. He’s a dewy-eyed idealist who gets excited about Mondays and brings homemade cookies to disciplinary meetings. 

Directed by: Seamus Carroll

Written by: Sam Thompson

Production Company: Rodeo House

Production Type: Indie Film

Compensation: 

The Boss -$250 (~2 days)

Lucas -$250 (~2 days)

Linda -$125 (1 day)

Meals provided 

Union Status: Non-Union

Shooting Dates: Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th (Subject to change) 

Filming Location: Denver, CO. 

PLEASE SEND:

An email to seamus@rodeohouse.net with

1. Your headshot

2. Links to any monologues/previous work/acting reel

3. Which role/s you are interested in

4. Your availability on Sunday (8/27) for an in person audition in downtown Denver

MY PREVIOUS WORK

THE THREE DOGS (2026)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hA6XY2-4ju8&t=836s

Casting Call (Short Film Paid)
Title: ELEKTRIK KATZENJAMMER

Genre: Psychological Thriller

Logline: The humdrum life of a corporate lackey is transformed when he discovers a mysterious cassette tape that brings him uncanny good fortune. However, in following the cryptic instructions the tape delivers, he finds that his newfound lucky breaks have made him the target of something far more sinister… 

Roles:

THE BOSS (Lead) Male, 40-50s, any race

Description: Years of self-preservation in a soulless capitalist bureaucracy have rendered The Boss greedy, insensate, and casually chauvinistic. However, beneath his vulgarity is a keen intellect that is always scanning for leverage and assessing the quickest route to an advantage. He is not outright evil, but his morality is flexible, especially when there is something to be gained, and he has climbed the corporate ladder through a combination of predatory instincts, oily charm, and an uncanny ability to recognize which way the wind is blowing.

LINDA (Supporting) Female, 40s, any race

Description: An ornery corporate matron. Her years of service have made her so indispensable to the company that firing her would constitute an act of administrative suicide. She has no particular ambitions to climb the corporate ladder, as she has already fashioned her little corner of the bureaucracy into a personal fiefdom. She is always prepared to die on the hill of whatever task is in front of her. Blunt, snippy, and occasionally inappropriate, she is in many ways a kindred spirit to the Boss, albeit one with less interest in upward mobility and more interest in making sure everyone else does their damn job.

LUCAS (Supporting) Male, 20s, any race

The yuppie naïf is the only one around the office who has not yet had his spirit crushed by the unending corporate drudgery. Painfully earnest and open-hearted, Lucas believes that enthusiasm is contagious, people mean well, and things always work out eventually. Although his eagerness is frequently mistaken for self-absorption, the truth is that Lucas simply has a lot to say, and he desperately wants someone to be interested. He’s a dewy-eyed idealist who gets excited about Mondays and brings homemade cookies to disciplinary meetings. 

Directed by: Seamus Carroll

Written by: Sam Thompson

Production Company: Rodeo House

Production Type: Indie Film

Compensation: 

The Boss -$250 (~2 days)

Lucas -$250 (~2 days)

Linda -$125 (1 day)

Meals provided 

Union Status: Non-Union

Shooting Dates: Saturday, October 24th and Sunday, October 25th (Subject to change) 

Filming Location: Denver, CO. 

PLEASE SEND:

An email to seamus@rodeohouse.net with

1. Your headshot

2. Links to any monologues/previous work/acting reel

3. Which role/s you are interested in

4. Your availability on Sunday (8/27) for an in person audition in downtown Denver

MY PREVIOUS WORK

THE THREE DOGS (2026)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hA6XY2-4ju8&t=836s

**Crew Call - Los Angeles** NO/LOW PAY

I'm looking for crew for a short film that will be used for a promotional and crowdfunding campaign. The writer/director and cinematographer are AFI alumni with established producers onboard. It will be a weekend 2 day shoot, currently targeting to film either October 10-11 or 17-18. Locations are yet to be confirmed but likely around LA and potentially Boyle Heights.

About the film:
The film follows a TikTok star suffering from an anxiety attack while stranded inside his trailer during a film shoot, but an unexpected encounter with a production assistant forces him out of his isolation and into a brief connection with the world around him. Our film explores the complexities of anxiety, isolation, and the self-imposed pressures we face in our pursuit of success.

As this is no-budget, we're only able to offer small stipends or kit fees. Although our goal is to find the crew we want to continue working with for the feature as well.

We're currently looking for:
Costume/Prop Master combo ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Sound Mixer w/gear ($300 flat stipend/kit fee)
Script Supervisor ($200 flat stipend/kit fee)
Intimacy Coordinator (1 day only, probably 8 hrs, $100 flat)

We are covered generally for other positions, but please feel free to send your resume in case of last minute availability changes.

If interested in collaborating, please email  sarahniver@gmail.com with your desired position in the subject line along with your resume or CV and portfolio (if applicable). Thank you so much!

Hi neighbors 🥰
I am local actor and model in Hernando County, in this amazing little town. I wanted to share a real that I created from an audition that landed me a music video with T-Pain, and then a commercial for Skinny Louie Smash Burgers. Feel free to share, love, and comment! Just a local woman trying to make it big over here.😉😉😎😎🤩🤩🥳🥳🔥🔥

They hired a model. They got a one-woman behind-the-scenes show. 😂

One minute I’m serving dramatic looks in the rain. The next, I’m making a Facebook reel between takes. 😂📸 To the photographers who capture the glamour and put up with my shenanigans: you deserve a raise. Which Sarah is your favorite—the dramatic model or the behind-the-scenes goofball? 👇✨

#SarahElizabeth #ModelLife #BehindTheScenes #PhotoshootFun #FacebookReels

New 3,000 sq ft Film & Photography Location – SE23
I am reaching out to introduce a new film and photography location available in Forest Hill, South-East London (SE23 1AN).

The property comprises approximately 3,000 sq ft of vacant space across two large, separate units, with free on-site parking.

The space could be suitable for:

• Film and TV productions

• Commercials and advertising campaigns

• Music videos

• Photography and fashion shoots

• Content production

• Set construction and art department work

• Production offices

• Equipment/prop storage

• Unit-base and production-support requirements

The property is currently empty, providing productions with considerable flexibility regarding layout, set dressing and use of the space.

Key advantages include:

• Approximately 3,000 sq ft

• Two large separate units

• Empty/flexible space

• Free on-site parking

• South-East London location

• Suitable for short-term production hire

• Potential for exclusive production use

I would be very interested in registering the property with your location library and would be happy to provide photographs, floor plans, access information and arrange a site visit/recce.

Please let me know the requirements for registering the property and the information you would need from me.

Yours faithfully,

Executive Director 

118 Malham Road,Forest Hill,

Lewisham,London, SE23 1AN. 

Web: www.nehemiahs.co.uk

Tel:  +44 (0) 0203 960 5050

Mob: +44 (0) 7380 856 900

New 3,000 sq ft Film & Photography Location – SE23
I am reaching out to introduce a new film and photography location available in Forest Hill, South-East London (SE23 1AN).

The property comprises approximately 3,000 sq ft of vacant space across two large, separate units, with free on-site parking.

The space could be suitable for:

• Film and TV productions

• Commercials and advertising campaigns

• Music videos

• Photography and fashion shoots

• Content production

• Set construction and art department work

• Production offices

• Equipment/prop storage

• Unit-base and production-support requirements

The property is currently empty, providing productions with considerable flexibility regarding layout, set dressing and use of the space.

Key advantages include:

• Approximately 3,000 sq ft

• Two large separate units

• Empty/flexible space

• Free on-site parking

• South-East London location

• Suitable for short-term production hire

• Potential for exclusive production use

I would be very interested in registering the property with your location library and would be happy to provide photographs, floor plans, access information and arrange a site visit/recce.

Please let me know the requirements for registering the property and the information you would need from me.

Yours faithfully,

Executive Director 

118 Malham Road,Forest Hill,

Lewisham,London, SE23 1AN. 

Web: www.nehemiahs.co.uk

Tel:  +44 (0) 0203 960 5050

Mob: +44 (0) 7380 856 900

Email: pga@nehemiahs.co.uk

items.text:
I joined this group with some hope of finding any way of breaking into acting, I have no actual experience although I came close many years ago before I had a family, I have also just tried recently and again I got very close as an extra but sadly I was released, unfortunately my circumstances dont allow for expensive headshots or acting classes plus the area I live isnt particularly a hub for films or tv apart from a couple that I know off. I am basically looking for advice on what steps I can take that wont cost me a lot of money to achieve.
Thank you for taking the time to read this.

topComments.text: The best thing I ever did was join an amateur theatre company. I've been in every production since I joined a year ago and they recognise my talent. I know I'm 49 and so may not make it in the acting world professionally but it's something that I love and that I need to do because it's in my blood. So I'm enjoying doing theatre even if I don't get paid for it. It was my escape when I was being bullied at school and helped me get into different characters to escape what was going on. If you want to do it for the love of it join an amateur theatre company. I've also got a btech national diploma in performing arts but it's best to go for the degree which you can do at any uni. I've also been on stage at the Rsc in Stratford upon Avon which was a community project. At least now I can say that I've done something with my talent, even if I never make it professionally.

🎬 KAMED STUDIO – NOWA PRODUKCJA FABULARNA
Nasza nowa produkcja fabularna przenosi się do Roztoki! 🎬

W związku z realizacją zdjęć poszukujemy statystów – kobiet, mężczyzn, seniorów, młodzieży oraz dzieci w wieku ok. 7–11 lat.

Szukamy również:

🚗 kierowców z własnymi samochodami, którzy mogą wystąpić w filmie razem z autem.

📅 Zdjęcia odbędą się w terminie 5–21 października.

📍 ROZTOKA

🚌 Dla osób z Wałbrzycha istnieje możliwość zorganizowania transportu produkcyjnego na plan.

👉 ZGŁOSZENIA PRZEZ FORMULARZ:

KLIKNIJ TUTAJ – FORMULARZ ZGŁOSZENIOWY⁠￼

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSedmV6jyYkfxi85xoioIkzLzKgOi4HMTwHKUMWw-1fa-i8okA/viewform?usp=header

Jeżeli ktoś ma problem z przesłaniem zgłoszenia przez formularz, prosimy o przesłanie zgłoszenia mailowo na:

📧 Roztoka.kamedstudio@gmail.com

W tytule wiadomości prosimy wpisać: ROZTOKA

W treści maila prosimy podać:

• imię i nazwisko

• numer telefonu

• adres zamieszkania

• informację, czy osoba dojeżdża na plan do Roztoki samodzielnie, czy potrzebuje transportu z Wałbrzycha

• dwa aktualne zdjęcia na jednolitym tle: portretowe + cała sylwetka

• w przypadku kierowców – dodatkowo zdjęcie samochodu, z którym mogą wystąpić w filmie.

Wysłanie zgłoszenia drogą mailową jest równoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie przesłanych danych osobowych przez Agencję Kamed Studio w związku z przeprowadzanym castingiem.

🎥 Zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

🎬 **ZAGRAJ W FILMIE! SZUKAMY STATYSTÓW NA SCENĘ IMPREZY!**

Dołącz do ekipy krótkometrażowego filmu dyplomowego **„Youth Parano”** (reż. Leon Korzyński i Witold Prokopczyk)!

Poprzedni film Leona został w tym roku wyróżniony **Studenckim Oscarem** (Academy Student Award) na festiwalu TIFF w Toronto – teraz ruszamy z kolejną, wyjątkową produkcją i potrzebujemy Waszej energii! 🔥

**O czym jest film?** To historia dwóch przyjaciół, którzy przeżywają ostatni dzień swoich ostatnich wspólnych wakacji.

**Kogo szukamy?** Przed nami realizacja jednej z największych i najbardziej energetycznych scen – **imprezy**, która jest kluczowym elementem całej historii. Zależy nam na stworzeniu pełnego, żywego klubowego świata, dlatego szukamy jak największej liczby osób, które staną z nami przed kamerą! 🕺💃

 

**SZCZEGÓŁY:**
* 📅 **Kiedy:** 10 października 2026 (sobota), w godz. 8:00 - 18:00
* 📍 **Gdzie:** Warszawa (jeden z warszawskich klubów)
* 💡 **Zasady:** Jako że jest to studencki film dyplomowy, projekt ma charakter **non-profit**.

Chcesz dołączyć do projektu i zagrać w filmie?

👉 **Wypełnij zgłoszenie tutaj:**[https://forms.gle/yRZGv4Cig3MozFaJ6](https://forms.gle/yRZGv4Cig3MozFaJ6)

**CASTING!**

Do reklamy gry komputerowej szukam mężczyzny do roli **BIKERA**!

**Lokalizacja:** Warszawa
**Zdjęcia:** 1 dzień zdjęciowy w terminie 8–10 października (dokładna data do potwierdzenia) + przymiarka

**BIKER — 45–55 lat**
Bardzo duży, fizycznie imponujący mężczyzna. Wysoki, szeroki w ramionach, o ciężkiej, surowej twarzy.

Najważniejsze są charyzma i spojrzenie. Patrzy lekko spode łba, prawie nie zmienia wyrazu twarzy, ale jednym uniesieniem brwi potrafi powiedzieć więcej niż ktoś inny całą kwestią.

Może być z brodą lub bez. Tatuaże nie są wymagane, preferowany brak widocznych tatuaży.

Nie próbuje nikogo straszyć — po prostu wygląda tak, że ludzie sami wolą zachować dystans. W rzeczywistości jest całkowicie spokojnym i normalnym człowiekiem. Na tym polega komedia: z wyglądu wydaje się najgroźniejszą osobą w pomieszczeniu, a zachowuje się znacznie spokojniej niż jego nowy znajomy.

**Szukamy:** bardzo wyrazistego spojrzenia, silnej obecności ekranowej i umiejętności grania minimalnymi środkami. Szczególnie ważne są spojrzenie spode łba, pauza i zaskoczone uniesienie brwi.

Bez przesadnej „gangsterskiej” gry — postać powinna być naturalnie surowa i charyzmatyczna.

Po wszystkie szczegóły zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej.

A może znasz kogoś odpowiedniego do tej roli?

**CASTING CALL - YOUNG FAMILIES**

Rose Waite Studio is casting real young families for a tech commercial. We’re specifically looking for real couples (30s) and single parents (30s) with children.

Filming: Mid October to 2nd November (one week)

Locations: London (on set, 1 day shoot) / In Talent’s Neighbourhood (where you’re based, 1 day shoot)

Talent can be based anywhere in the UK.

No previous experience needed to apply but talent should be comfortable with self shooting. 

Paid opportunity.

To apply, please send full names, location, selfie and family intro to: stories@rosewaite.com with the subject Young Family (UK)

Mein neues Musikvideo ist fertig: „Words We Left Unsaid“.

Eigentlich sollte es ein Musikvideo werden. Während der Arbeit daran ist daraus immer mehr ein kleiner Film geworden – über zwei Menschen, Nähe und Distanz, Erinnerungen und all die Worte, die unausgesprochen bleiben.

Musik, Text und Gesang stammen von mir; produziert und eingespielt habe ich den Song in meinem eigenen Studio. Die Bilder und Videosequenzen habe ich mit KI für die Geschichte gestaltet und anschließend im Videoprogramm zum fertigen Film zusammengesetzt und dort Sound-Effekte ergänzt.

Hier könnt ihr ihn direkt ansehen. Am besten mit Ton – und vielleicht bis ganz zum Schluss (Cliffhänger!). 😉

Wenn euch das Video gefällt: Auf meinem YouTube-Kanal „Molle am Sax“ findet ihr meine Musik und weitere Videos. Den Link zum Kanal findet ihr hier:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCRdS2Z7fNvwy1dmAxE1kH_w

Mich würde besonders interessieren: Wie interpretiert ihr das Ende?

CASTING CALL !

When the Sun Dies 

Hi we are currently casting for a student film!

Title: When the Sun Dies 

Logline: A young woman is dealing with the loss of a mother she barely knew. The answers might lie within the masked figures haunting her. 

Synopsis: 21 year old Luna recently lost her mother. A mother she had a very poor relationship with growing up. Now she's struggling with the right way to grieve someone who was never there for her. Lucky for her a strange distraction comes at exactly the right time. Haunted by visions of the sun, she might be able to see her mother again for who she wanted to be. 

Runtime: Roughly 8 minutes 

Filming Dates: October 11, 13, 17, 25 

Union Status: Non-Union 

Unpaid: Meals will be provided 

We will be holding open auditions on September 29th at the Auraria Campus Media Center from 2-3:15. There is also an option to Audition online through the form linked. 

Reach out with any questions and go to the link provided for more information! Thank You! 

https://linktr.ee/sauerwork05

Akademia Sceny wystartowała! Mamy jeszcze miejsca w grupie! Może czakamy właśnie na Ciebie?

Poznaj nas! Jesteśmy duetem twórczym. Działamy od wielu lat. Z zawodu Jesteśmy aktorami. Ale odeszliśmy z teatru. Postanowiliśmy zbudować własną przestrzeń. W poszanowaniu dla granic. Bez przemocy i presji. Tworzymy własny teatr - profesjonalne spektakle. Prowadzimy też warsztaty artystyczne. Zapraszamy Cię do naszej Akademii Sceny. Spotykamy się w gronie dorosłych i młodzieży. Uczymy profesjonalnego teatru. Tworzymy spektakle. Wymieniamy doświadczenia. Odpoczywamy. Działamy w poczuciu bezpieczeństwa i z dbałością o dobrostan emocjonalny. Dołącz do drużyny Czułego Teatru!

SPRING / SUMMER 2026 — CAPE TOWN

A.L.T. is casting female bikini models for an ongoing summer beach photoshoot project starting in October.

Experienced and first-time models are welcome.

PROJECT DETAILS
• Cape Town beach locations
• Shoot days scheduled according to weather & production requirements
• Typically 1–2 shoot days per week, with some weeks skipped
• Approx. 3–5 hours per shoot
• R1,440 per selected model, per shoot day
• No usage fee
• Professional swimwear shoot — no nudity

REQUIREMENTS
18+ • bikini/swimwear-ready physique • confident on camera • reliable • own swimwear + towel

TO APPLY:
DM or WhatsApp 076 180 2729 with:

1. Name and age
2. Measurements 
3. Cape Town location
4. 3–4 recent photos (clear, natural, full-body + close-up)
5. Instagram/TikTok link (not handle)
6. Modelling experience, if any

Selected talent will receive shoot dates directly based on project requirements.

A.L.T. | Astra Logistics & Talent
People. Opportunities. Beyond.

items.text:
Szukam osób/aktorów w wieku 35+ do nagrywania prostych wideo własnym smartfonem w stylu UGC.

🔴 CZYTAJ DO KOŃCA ZANIM NAPISZESZ

Szukam osób w wieku 35+ do stałej współpracy.  Nagrania to zwykłe wideo mówione (telefonem, bez montażu, bez wrzucania na swoje profile, duża elastyczność i dowolność wyboru scenerii). Wideo będzie wykorzystywane do kampanii reklamowych w social mediach, promujących usługi naszej firmy.

Co jest do zrobienia:

Nagranie krótkich wypowiedzi wg prostego scenariusza (surowy materiał).

Pierwsze zlecenie: pakiet 10 nagrań (15-45 sekund każde) = 500 zł za komplet. 

Przy sprawnej realizacji - stała, regularna współpraca.

Wymagania:

Telefon z dobrą kamerą i czystym dźwiękiem, światło dzienne, naturalność przed kamerą, swoboda wypowiedzi.

Chcesz spróbować?

Wyślij mi na prywatną wiadomość krótki (nawet 15-20 sek.) filmik próbkowy nagrany telefonem - powiedz do kamery jak masz na imię, ile masz lat i np. co dzisiaj robiłeś/aś. Bez obróbki i filtrów. Wybrane osoby dostaną skrypt do pierwszego pakietu.

🎬 CASTING CALL | BERLIN

We are looking for **two actors** for our student short film **PUTZFRAU**, produced as part of our **Beta Project at FilmArche**.

📍 Berlin
🎥 Shooting: **27–29 November 2026**
💰 Unpaid student production

**MALE LEAD | 35–40**

We are looking for someone who presents as **Greek, Spanish, Italian or Southeastern European**, with **dark hair and a medium build**.

The role includes a scene involving physical confrontation, which will be choreographed. Acting experience is welcome but not required.

**FEMALE ROLE | 40–50**

We are looking for a **German woman**, playing age 40–50.
The role has **very little dialogue**.

**ABOUT THE FILM**

After a backbreaking day at work, an immigrant cleaner’s simmering rage overflows when he encounters a wounded German protester who becomes the target of his fury.

The film explores how financial hardship, systemic marginalization and social exclusion can contribute to anger and radicalization.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Please send:

📸 A recent photo
🎭 A short introduction
📅 Your availability for **27–29 November**

📩 **[zelihacenkci@outlook.com](mailto:zelihacenkci@outlook.com)**** OR Facebook DM! **

Previous acting experience is not required.

If you know someone who might be a good fit, please feel free to **share this post or tag them**. Thank you! 🖤

Blackpool’s original 1920s cinema The Regent is playing host to an international festival of short films which is normally staged in Manchester.

The white tiled Art Deco cinema, on the corner of Church Street and Regent Road, will welcome the special 10th anniversary edition of ‘From the Vaults’ on Saturday October 3, from 7pm.

Among the films being shown is the latest opus from Fylde coast filmmaker Anton Arenko, a quirky and warm-hearted release called Malcolm’s Subject.

This documentary follows Malcolm Wilson, a former campsite owner who after closing his site, sought human contact through his pursuit of UFOs and other phenomena.

Anton, whose other films included a tribute piece to the Fleetwood to Knott End Ferry, called End to End, launched a crowdfunding appeal to get Malcolm’s Subject wrapped up, and was delighted when the campaign raised the £1,200.

This year’s From the Vaults festival will feature a dozen short indie films from around the world.

Festival organiser Andy Green said: “Our Manchester indie film night is coming to Blackpool as part of our 10th birthday celebrations.

“Everyone is welcome to come along to view the indie films, there will be filmmakers there talking about their work, we will have networking time and time available for people to talk about their projects in the works or ideas for next year.

“Due to the age of this building, my apologies but there is no lift upto the seating area. Please be mindful that you will be able to get up to the seating area.”

Anton, who worked with cinematographer Iain Cash on his latest film, said: “I’ve been going to this festival to see these films for years, so to have a film of my own involved is brilliant, especially in a venue such as The Regent.

“I’d like to thank everyone who helped me make my film possible. It should be a brilliant night.”

Tickets cost £5 and and can be obtained via the visit Film Vault Presents Facebook page or on the door.

**CASTING NOTICE**

Non-Equity Call; $50/performance

Trinity Theatre Company is seeking actors to fill all roles for *POTUS* by Selina Fillinger, directed by Kandace Crystal and performing January 8-17, 2027. Also seeking actors to fill most roles in the world premier of The House Between by Serhat Pala, directed by Sean Boyd and performing February 26 - March 14, 2027.

**Auditions:** In-Person appointments on October 20th. Please prepare a 1-2 minute monologue of your choice. Submissions are being taken online through [Sign Up Genius](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions). All submissions must be submitted through this platform. ([https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/8050C48AEAD2CA4F49-66194263-auditions))

Prior to auditions, you will be emailed to submit a *digital *copy of your headshot & resume. Hard copies are not required, and will not be taken.

**Important Dates for *****POTUS***:

December 1 – First Rehearsal

December 29 - January 7 – Tech

January 8 - January 17 – Performances

****Break for Christmas Week and New Year Holidays****

**Important Dates for *****The House Between***:

January 12 – First Rehearsal

February 16-25 – Tech

February 26 - March 14 – Performances

**Location:**

All Rehearsals & Performances will take place at the Trinity Theatre Company, 9520 Padgett Street, Suite 208, San Diego, CA 92126

Rehearsals Tuesdays - Fridays from 6p-10p.

Performances Fridays & Saturdays at 7p; Sundays at 2p.

**Character Breakdown:**

****Actors of all ethnicities, race, age, and gender are encouraged to apply****

POTUS:

HARRIET - His Chief of Staff

JEAN - His press secretary

STEPHANIE - His secretary

DUSTY - His dalliance

BERNADETTE - His sister

CHRIS - A journalist

MARGARET - His wife. The First Lady.

THE HOUSE BETWEEN:

CHRISSY -Greek–Australian. 50s–60s.

A painter and mother living in Melbourne. Warm, witty, and emotionally brave beneath a practiced competence. Carries the “unfinished story” of her grandfather and a restless need to stand inside the place it began.

JOHN -Chrissy’s son. Late 20s–30s.

Protective, skeptical, articulate. Thinks structurally (risk, logistics, consequences). His love often arrives as interrogation first, tenderness second.

ATHENA -Chrissy’s daughter. 20s

Bright, affectionate, and perceptive. The first to offer warmth, the quickest to name what’s happening in the room; often the bridge between generations.

HAKAN -Turkish–American. 50s–60s.

An academic (a professor). Disciplined, cerebral, private; until the right silence breaks him open. He’s spent a lifetime explaining history; now he has to live inside it. His emotional center is steadier than he expects.

ARDA - THIS ROLE HAS BEEN CAST - Hakan’s son. 20s.

Startup founder building AI; ambitious, fast, sincere. Wants speed and scale, but still shows up when family becomes real. Capable of surprising gentleness. Special connection to father, almost the Hakan that could have been.

SAM -Hakan’s longtime friend. 50s–60s.

Semi-retired executive / mentor type. Warm, dry, and socially fluent; he can defuse tension without minimizing it. A steady witness - sometimes a referee, sometimes a catalyst.

IRFAN -Local fixer/contractor/paperwork operator. 40s–50s.

An indispensable “solver” who sells solutions and then invents them. Big-hearted, opportunistic, funny without being a clown. Carries a tape measure like a sword. Wants to be essential (and paid). Often the play’s pressure-valve, but with real stakes underneath. Not meant to be a cartoonish character with more substance than quickly visible on the surface.

METIN - Local falcon enthusiast / informal guide. Age flexible (30s–70s).

Arrives with tea and an overstuffed “logbook” energy. Speaks in folk-poetic metaphor that lands more deeply than he intends. Slightly mystical, slightly practical, like the town itself.

*About the Shows:*

***POTUS - ***One four-letter word is about to rock 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue. When the President unwittingly spins a PR nightmare into a global crisis, the seven brilliant and beleaguered women he relies upon most risk life, liberty, and the pursuit of sanity to keep the commander-in-chief out of trouble.

***The House Between ***- “The House Between” is about two immigrants drawn to the same ruined house from opposite histories. Chrissy, a Greek-Australian artist, and Hakan, a Turkish-American historian, meet in Ayvalık, Türkiye, and begin a late-in-life love story shaped by memory, family, and displacement. The play asks: when you carry more than one home inside you, how do you choose where you belong?

**URGENT CASTING: JIGSAW CASTING IS LOOKING FOR CANADIAN BASED AMERICAN GIRLS AGES 13-16. MUST STILL HAVE AMERICAN ACCENT SOCCER / FOOTBALL PLAYERS WITH GOOD ABILITY**

This is casting in Canada but filming in Brazil. All travel and accommodation are included for talent and one parent.

We are continuing the Dove campaign to keep our girls in sport – and for this project in particular, soccer! For more information: https://bit.ly/doveconfidentsports

Girls are too often being told their bodies are wrong for sports. Too tall. Too short. Too strong. Too soft. We’re not losing girls because they can’t play. We’re losing them because the world tells them their bodies don’t fit the game.

Our film invites us to talk about their first touch, their passes, their shots. We will be filming real football on the pitch, on the street - wherever our girls are playing.

We are looking for 13 - 16 year-old girls ( with American accents) who actively have a high or medium level of football from various positions: goalkeeper; striker; centre, defence.

We are looking for a broader range of body shapes, sizes, abilities, ages, football levels to make sure it’s more universal and inclusive. We want real footballers, with their real bodies.

For this video we are NOT looking for girls that are currently signed with model / acting agencies or that have already taken part in any professional modelling or advertising.

Filming will be in Brazil - which is the venue for next year’s Women’s World Cup – there will be girls from different countries taking part and all travel / hotels for selected girls plus one parent will be arranged and paid for. Such a great opportunity !!

**Must be available for these key dates:**

Callbacks: October 14 or 15, 2026. Via zoom.

Filming / Photography

In November we estimate approx. 5 days to include travel, prep and filming:

Travel: Between November 23 to 25 to Brazil. Return home on November 28, 2026.

Shoot: November 26 and 27, 2026.

Payments come in two parts:

Day rates are paid to the girls confirmed for this project for the actual days booked and generally about 4 - 5 weeks after filming.

DAY RATES: - rates given in Euros as per contract per person.

Travel / Prep etc - 130 euros

Filming - 257.50 euros

Parents (Chaperone ) 100 dollars per day ( not incl callback)

Usages - global all media - 12 months

Hero - speaking talent - 5,500 euros

Supporting/ non featured - 2,750 euros

**Deadline: ASAP or before September 28, 2026 at 10am EST.**

Usage is not guaranteed as it is subject to your appearance in the final live materials, final media plan and paid once these are live – Spring 2027. The planned rates are - global all media - 12 months. We will have a better idea which category your child is in after the callbacks.

If interested, please apply with a self tape to:

https://dovesoccer.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:

https://bit.ly/dovesoccerselftape

I’m looking for two young actresses for a new series project, The Ausländer Diaries. And extras

Eva & Lana PAID
• Playing age: 14–17
• Both must speak Russian, English
• Filming in Berlin
• Planned for February 2027
• Paid role – €500 for two filming days

items.text:
THE LATEST COMEDY SHOW IN POLAND?

Abby Roberge + Ari Mannis + Impact Fest After Hours

Saturday, 26 September | Warsaw

Impact Fest has added one more Saturday-night show.

American-based comedians Abby Roberge and Ari Mannis are in Warsaw, and both are performing a full stand-up set before the festival moves into its late-night after-hours session.

That means headline stand-up, followed by comedians from Impact Fest, Warsaw and around the world taking over the stage through the night.

ABBY ROBERGE

Originally from Vancouver and now based in Los Angeles, Abby Roberge was selected as a Just For Laughs New Face and has performed across the US and Canada, including residencies at the Laugh Factory in Las Vegas. He has appeared on Modern Family, NBC’s So Close and CBC’s Comedy Night with Rick Mercer.

Abby has toured with comedians including Bill Burr, Russell Peters and Bob Saget, and his stand-up and sketch videos have accumulated more than 100 million views, according to his Laugh Factory biography.

ARI MANNIS

Los Angeles-based comedian Ari Mannis performs internationally as a headliner and has toured opening for comedians including Mark Normand, Theo Von, Andrew Santino, Dan Soder, Erik Griffin, Michael Kosta and Pauly Shore.

His comedy has appeared through MTV, SiriusXM, Nerdist, Funny or Die, CollegeHumor and TBS, and he has performed at festivals including Laughing Skull, Big Pine and Laugh Your Asheville Off.

AND THEN THE NIGHT KEEPS MOVING

After Abby and Ari finish, the festival shifts into Draw From The Hat, Impact Fest After Hours.

Comedians visiting Warsaw for Impact Fest join local performers, names go into the hat and the lineup develops throughout the night.

We know who starts the evening.

We are much less certain who finishes it.

SATURDAY NIGHT

Abby Roberge 

Ari Mannis 

Then: Draw From The Hat - Impact Fest After Hours

TICKETS

49 PLN online

60 PLN at the door, subject to availability

Included with Impact Fest Saturday Pass and Weekend Pass

Saturday, 26 September 2026

Impact Fest 2026 Warsaw

Come for two full international headline sets. Stay to see how far into Sunday we get.

AKTOR DO OBSADY ROLI MĘSKIEJ W TEATRZE DLA DZIECI

Teatr Gargulec szuka aktora do regularnej współpracy przy objazdowych spektaklach dla dzieci.

Najważniejsze warunki:

• minimum 5100 zł netto miesięcznie przy uzgodnionej dyspozycyjności i przyjmowaniu zaproponowanych terminów,

• 140 zł netto za każdy spektakl,

• dodatkowo 20 zł netto za każdy dzień wyjazdowy, w którym aktor prowadzi samochód,

• co najmniej 35 przedstawień miesięcznie,

• umowa zlecenia,

• spektakle głównie w dni powszednie rano i przed południem,

• Warszawa i trasy do około 100 km,

• wyjazdy jednodniowe, bez noclegów.

Nie wymagamy szkoły aktorskiej ani doświadczenia zawodowego. Szukamy osoby energicznej, wyrazistej, odpowiedzialnej i swobodnej na scenie. Warunkiem jest czynne prawo jazdy kategorii B oraz pewne prowadzenie samochodu po Warszawie i na trasach podmiejskich.

Przed zgłoszeniem odpowiedz sobie na trzy pytania:

1. Czy regularnie możesz pracować w dni powszednie od wczesnych godzin porannych?

2. Czy swobodnie prowadzisz samochód po Warszawie?

3. Czy szukasz współpracy na cały sezon, a nie zajęcia na kilka tygodni?

Pierwszy etap castingu odbywa się przez internet. Wybranym osobom wysyłamy krótką scenę do nagrania. Charakter naszej pracy można zobaczyć tutaj:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NJe9pGesf7E&t=28s

Zgłoszenia: biuro@teatrgargulec.pl

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas Goersch

Statister med en lille skuespiller i maven søges til filmoptagelse af en beredskabsøvelse ved Nordic Seaplanes, Nordre Toldbod 29, 1259 København K. 

Vi søger statister til en stor øvelse som afholdes med beredskabsinstanserne i København. 

Rollerne går ud på at spille pårørende til tilskadekomne, nysgerrige journalister, turister og lignende karakterer man kunne se ved en stor ulykke. 

Des mere man kan leve sig ind i en rolle og gør sceneriet virkelighedsnært, jo bedre. Og man skal gerne være i stand til at improvisere.

Man vil skulle spille rollerne foran reelt politi, brandvæsen, og paramediciner. 

Filmen er udelukkende til internt brug.

Optagelserne finder sted den onsdag 28. Oktober 2026 med mødested Nordre Tolbod 29, København fra klokken 10:00 til 13:00 med kaffe og kage efter. 

Jobbet er ulønnet, men vi honorerer indsatsen med et gavekort til en rundflyvning over København med vandflyveren. 

Vi garanterer for en spændende og sjov dag. 

Send venligst pb ved interesse, og jeg vender tilbage snarest muligt. 

Med venlig hilsen
Lauda Waldof
Statist koordinator.

Mvh Karoline Juul

CASTING CALL FOR EXTRAS! Unpaid but fed!

We’re looking for local people of all ages and backgrounds to appear as extras in Santa Express The Movie, a new British family Christmas feature film being shot in York and North Yorkshire from the 5th to the 25th October.

Unfortunately, as we are a small-team, low-budget film, we are unable to provide payment for our extras, however we will make sure you are well fed and taken care of during your time with us!

Extras will only be required for one half day of shooting each (though are able to do multiple days if you wish!)

The film stars Peter Purves as Father Christmas, alongside Toyah Willcox, Victoria Ekanoye, Joe Savino, Fiona Sinnott and a wonderful ensemble cast.

Set against the magical backdrop of Christmas in York and the North Yorkshire Moors Railway, Santa Express is a warm, funny and uplifting family film filled with steam trains, snow, Christmas magic and plenty of heart.

If this is a project you are interested in being a part of, please message me here, or email me at laurenlenihansmith@gmail.com for more info on dates! We need extras across the whole shooting schedule, so we will likely be able to fit you in whenever works for you.

150 days to go until Resolution:The Musical premiere's at The Halifax Playhouse. Three shows on February 25th, 26th & 27th 2027. The set is in construction, the band is playing and rehearsals start in October but we find ourselves having to recast two principal parts.

Alvin Corbet (50 – 65 years) – Bar manager and MC for the open-mic night. Alvin is a sharply dressed, larger than life host. He introduces the acts, and makes all the announcements. He tells jokes, creates the atmosphere and keeps the show going. Everybody loves Alvin. We later find out that, underneath the carefree surface, Alvin is not what he seems. A good man, haunted by his own demons.
Requirements: Strong singing voice, experienced actor, with the ability to portray both humour and pathos.

Zak-Attak (18 years) - Writes and records songs in his bedroom and is becoming an international success on TikTok, with his own particular brand of techno. He has a strong relationship with his adopted sister Jem. She writes the lyrics to go with his music. 
Requirements: Strong singing voice, experienced actor. Will need to portray Gen-z teen with an endearing older-brotherly warmth. Must have a sense of comedy timing.

The characters are not ethnicity specific, so we encourage people fro all backgrounds to apply.

We are having to stage these shows on an amateur basis but we have big ambittions for the future of the show. If you think you could perform one of these parts please get in touch ASAP by email: info@resrocks.com. We'd love to meet you

Jigsaw Casting Ltd. Is Seeking Cigarette Smokers ages 30+ across Canada who have cut back or are trying to quit for a ZONNIC Testimonial Campaign!

We are looking for the following people:
1. Individuals who are actively quitting or cutting back with ZONNIC. You are currently using the product and able to speak to it first-hand.

2. Individuals who are looking to quit or cut back — and you are open to trying ZONNIC. You are motivated to change the habit, not yet a ZONNIC user. You are open to trying the product ahead of the shoot.

3. Individuals who have tried other NRTs without success — open to switching. Those who have attempted to quit with other nicotine replacement therapies that did not work.

4. Individuals who have recently quit by using ZONNIC.

If selected – This is a compensated, non-union project, with total potential compensation of up to $5,100.00 per person, depending on final usage and survival of the edit. Buyout includes all lifts, edits and versions for a 1 year period.

Requirements
• Aged 30+ and visually read as 30+ on camera.
• Resides in Canada. Everyday Canadians from diverse backgrounds
• Currently smokes and is either cutting back or looking to quit, able to describe it unprompted.
• Comfortable speaking honestly and being publicly attributed.

DEADLINE TO SUBMIT - ASAP OR BEFORE OCTOBER 7, 2026 AT 9AM EST.
You must be available for these dates if selected:

Recall: October 16 via in person (Montreal) or zoom (other cities).

Shoot: 1 day in between Nov 19 to 30. Location TBD: Either in Montreal, Toronto or Vancouver. Travel and accommodation will be provided if you don't live close to the studio in one of those cities. Travel dates will be 1 or 2 days before the shoot.

If interested, you must apply and submit a self tape to:
https://zonniccampaign.castingcrane.com/

Self tape instructions:
1. Introduce yourself.
2. What makes you want to quit or cut back?
3. What personal goals is ZONNIC helping you unlock?

SZUKAMY GRAFIKA DO ANIMACJI/OBRAZÓW 

Cześć wszystkim!
Szukamy grafika, który przygotowałby animacje, obrazy do filmu amatorskiego 'Cień Korony'. Zależy nam na szybkiej realizacji bez użycia AI (póki co mamy przygotowane poglądowe animacje w formie wygenerowanej przez sztuczną inteligencję). 
Premiera filmu jest planowana na 4 grudnia tego roku. Film będzie puszczony w toruńskim Młodzieżowym Domu Kultury na wielkim ekranie w sali widowiskowej.
Niestety ze względu na formę nagrywek, nie jesteśmy w stanie zaoferować pieniężnego wynagrodzenia, a jedynie pokazanie pracy na wspomnianym dużym ekranie oraz później na kanale na YouTubie.

PAID: £25/hr, London, two dates models needed ASAP 
Hi all, we're running a clothing fitting session and need people of specific sizes to try on a small selection of clothes so we can see how they fit. It's about the clothes, not you, so no modelling experience needed, you just stand there. Small friendly team, professional studio, relaxed session.

This one is in two parts and you need to be free for both:

Day 1: Wednesday 1 October, Clerkenwell. A 45 minute slot for measurements and a couple of reference photos. 

Day 2: Monday 5 October OR Friday 9 October, Belgravia. The fitting itself. Up to around 4 hours, possibly less. £25 per hour for the time you're there.

Please only apply if you can definitely do Wednesday plus one of the following week dates. Day 1 is only useful to us if you come back for Day 2, so we'll ask you to confirm both in writing when your slot is booked.

We do need your height, weight and a full-length photo before confirming, as we're matching to specific sizes.

Hong Kong’s acclaimed film of the year, 《We’re Nothing At All（我們不是什麼）》will arrive in Los Angeles in October. Director Herman Yau (邱禮濤導演), along with lead actors AK (江𤒹生) from the Hong Kong group Mirror ，and Ansonbean (陳毅燊), will hold three screening and Q&A events in Los Angeles on October 7, 9, and 10. 

Everyone is welcome to register and purchase tickets to attend.

*Please check the official website of the organizer, Blacklight Global Entertainment, for ticket details:

https://www.blacklight-global.com

Official Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/blacklightglobal.usa?stkn=MXQ3cXZiazV2MWNuaw==

You are welcome to register and purchase tickets to participate.

https://www.international.ucla.edu/ccs/event/17766

——————————

**CASTING!**

Do reklamy gry komputerowej szukam mężczyzny do roli **BIKERA**!

**Lokalizacja:** Warszawa
**Zdjęcia:** 1 dzień zdjęciowy w terminie 8–10 października (dokładna data do potwierdzenia) + przymiarka

**BIKER — 45–55 lat**
Bardzo duży, fizycznie imponujący mężczyzna. Wysoki, szeroki w ramionach, o ciężkiej, surowej twarzy.

Najważniejsze są charyzma i spojrzenie. Patrzy lekko spode łba, prawie nie zmienia wyrazu twarzy, ale jednym uniesieniem brwi potrafi powiedzieć więcej niż ktoś inny całą kwestią.

Może być z brodą lub bez. Tatuaże nie są wymagane, preferowany brak widocznych tatuaży.

Nie próbuje nikogo straszyć — po prostu wygląda tak, że ludzie sami wolą zachować dystans. W rzeczywistości jest całkowicie spokojnym i normalnym człowiekiem. Na tym polega komedia: z wyglądu wydaje się najgroźniejszą osobą w pomieszczeniu, a zachowuje się znacznie spokojniej niż jego nowy znajomy.

**Szukamy:** bardzo wyrazistego spojrzenia, silnej obecności ekranowej i umiejętności grania minimalnymi środkami. Szczególnie ważne są spojrzenie spode łba, pauza i zaskoczone uniesienie brwi.

Bez przesadnej „gangsterskiej” gry — postać powinna być naturalnie surowa i charyzmatyczna.

Po wszystkie szczegóły zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej.

A może znasz kogoś odpowiedniego do tej roli?

Nie próbuje nikogo straszyć — po prostu wygląda tak, że ludzie sami wolą zachować dystans. W rzeczywistości jest całkowicie spokojnym i normalnym człowiekiem. Na tym polega komedia: z wyglądu wydaje się najgroźniejszą osobą w pomieszczeniu, a zachowuje się znacznie spokojniej niż jego nowy znajomy.

**Szukamy:** bardzo wyrazistego spojrzenia, silnej obecności ekranowej i umiejętności grania minimalnymi środkami. Szczególnie ważne są spojrzenie spode łba, pauza i zaskoczone uniesienie brwi.

Bez przesadnej „gangsterskiej” gry — postać powinna być naturalnie surowa i charyzmatyczna.

Po wszystkie szczegóły zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej.

A może znasz kogoś odpowiedniego do tej roli?

Alle herrer/mænd i alderen 18-40 år, der ikke allerede har været til audition på Musicalteatrets kommende opsætning af “Jack the Ripper: The Musical”, er velkomne til at tilmelde sig. Tilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

🎬 CASTING DO SPOTU REKLAMOWEGO
Role bez tekstu.

Zgłoszenia tylko drogą mailową

Poszukujemy aktorów/epizodystów:

Mężczyzna — 24 lata

Młody, atrakcyjny mężczyzna o wyrazistej twarzy i ciemnych włosach. Szczupła, proporcjonalna sylwetka.

Typ: miejski, nowoczesny, premium / corporate.

Zadbany, pewny siebie, ambitny, ale jednocześnie ciepły i rodzinny.

Ważna naturalność i swoboda przed kamerą.

Kobieta — 19 lat

Młoda kobieta o charakterystycznej, naturalnej urodzie i wyrazistej twarzy. Długie ciemne włosy, szczupła sylwetka.

Typ: niezależna, współczesna, z charakterem.

Mile widziana naturalna, nieoczywista uroda i mocna ekranowa osobowość.

Mężczyzna — 70–80 lat

Senior o bardzo charakterystycznej twarzy, siwych włosach i zaroście. Szczupła lub średnia sylwetka.

Szukamy osoby ciepłej, wiarygodnej i emocjonalnej, potrafiącej opowiadać historię przede wszystkim spojrzeniem i mimiką.

Naturalność i autentyczność mile widziane.

Mężczyzna — 30–40 lat

Przystojny, charakterystyczny mężczyzna o wyrazistych rysach i ciemnych włosach.

Postać pojawia się w kilku okresach życia: 1968 / 1972 / 1975 / 1980, dlatego ważna jest możliwość wiarygodnego pokazania upływu czasu.

Typ: charyzmatyczny, męski, ekranowy.

Kobieta — 30–40 lat

Kobieta o ciepłej, klasycznej urodzie i charakterystycznej twarzy.

Kobieca, elegancka, rodzinna, naturalna.

Postać również pokazujemy w różnych okresach – lata 60., 70. i 80.

Ważna umiejętność wiarygodnego przechodzenia między różnymi etapami życia i stylami epoki.

Kobieta — 40–50 lat

Ciepła, zadbana, atrakcyjna kobieta o naturalnym wyglądzie.

Typ: współczesna mama – silna, troskliwa, rodzinna.

Naturalna mimika i wiarygodność przed kamerą ważniejsze niż „modelowy” wygląd.

Mężczyzna — 45–55 lat

Zadbany, męski, naturalny mężczyzna. Krótkie ciemne włosy, możliwy lekki zarost.

Typ: spokojny, pracowity, rodzinny tata.

Szukamy naturalności, ciepła i wiarygodności, bez przesadnie „reklamowego” wizerunku.

📍 Zdjęcia w Warszawie w 2 połowie października 

📩 Zgłoszenia:

blackwolfproductionpl@gmail.com

📝 W treści zgłoszenia podaj:

• Imię i nazwisko

• Wiek

• Numer telefonu

• Zdjęcie twarzy i całej sylwetki

• Wizytówka lub/i demo (link do YouTube)

Pozostałe szczegóły przekażemy wybranym osobom.

Casting für junge Künstler:

Dinnershow im Krönum

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

 

Wir suchen junge, kreative Künstler aus den Bereichen Akrobatik, Tanz, Musik, Comedy und mehr, die Lust haben, bei einer exklusiven Dinnershow im Krönum mitzumachen. Du kannst dich auch gerne als Duo bewerben!

 

So kannst du dich bewerben:

 

-   Schick uns ein kurzes Video (max. 3 Minuten) von deinem Auftritt oder einer Performance, die du vor kurzem durchgeführt hast. Zeige uns deine Fähigkeiten und deine Leidenschaft für die Bühne!

-   Wir treffen eine Vorauswahl und laden die ausgewählten Künstler zu einem persönlichen Casting ein, das am 01.10. stattfinden wird. In absoluten Ausnahmefällen ist auch ein anderer Termin auf Anfrage möglich.

 

Warum teilnehmen?

-   Du erhältst die Chance, Teil einer einzigartigen Dinnershow im Krönum zu werden.

-   ﻿Die Shows beginnen im März und enden im Dezember. Gespielt wird an den Wochenenden und in den sächsischen Ferien. Details folgen.

-   ﻿﻿Es warten spannende Auftrittsmöglichkeiten und ein kreatives Team auf dich.

**Du bist ein talentierter Künstler und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einer einzigartigen Dinnershow präsentieren? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!**

🎬 **BEZAHLTER COMEDY-WERBEDREH: **

**Frau ca. 45–65 Jahre für diesen Freitag in Wien gesucht**

Für ein kurzes Social-Media-Werbevideo mit einem bekannten österreichischen Creator suchen wir kurzfristig eine sympathische, humorvolle Frau, die gerne vor der Kamera steht.

**Die Rolle:**
Du spielst überspitzt eine verliebte österreichische Urlauberin, die ihren jüngeren nordafrikanischen Urlaubspartner am Flughafen abholt. Der Clip ist eine klar erkennbare und humorvolle Parodie auf bekannte TV-Datingformate (Amore unter Palmen etc.).

**Drehdetails:**
📅 Freitag, 25. September
🕗 Start gegen 8/9 Uhr
⏱ Ca. 3–4 Stunden
📍 Wien und eine kurze Szene beim Flughafen
💶 Bezahlter Dreh – Vergütung inkludiert
🎥 Veröffentlichung als Social-Media-Werbevideo (mit Rechten zur Nutzung und Bewerbung)

Schauspielerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich! Wichtig sind Humor, Natürlichkeit, Lockerheit vor der Kamera und die Bereitschaft, die verliebte Rolle etwas überspitzt zu spielen.

Bei Interesse bitte möglichst rasch eine kurze Nachricht mit Foto, Telefonnummer und, falls vorhanden, einem kurzen Video oder Social-Media-Profil schicken. 😊

PPG MEDIA IS EXPANDING TO SOUTH AFRICA! 🇿🇦🇧🇼
Are you in Johannesburg, South Africa and interested in becoming a professional model? This is your opportunity! 

PPG MEDIA MODELING ACADEMY & AGENCY is now opening registrations for aspiring models in South Africa.

You do NOT need previous modeling experience. We take beginners, train and develop them into professional models, then work with them to create opportunities in the modeling industry across South Africa 🇿🇦 and Botswana 🇧🇼.

WHAT YOU GET:

✅ Professional modeling training — FREE

✅ FREE photoshoots

✅ Access to 25+ modeling categories

✅ Professional grooming & development

✅ Opportunities for modeling jobs & bookings

✅ Opportunities to work between Botswana & South Africa

REGISTRATION: R300

📍 Johannesburg, South Africa

🏢 PPG MEDIA OFFICE: Gaborone, Broadhurst Industrial

📞 South Africa: +27 78 401 6667

📞 Botswana: +267 74 853 291

Your journey can start with no experience.

MODEL TODAY. PROFESSIONAL TOMORROW.

 DM us now to register or enquire.

Previous acting experience is welcome, but young/emerging talent is encouraged to apply.
